from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Drugstore Stocking Safety Planning
    
    This is a working example used as a template for LLM code generation.
    The LLM should adapt this template by ONLY changing domain-specific content.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.shelf = Object("shelf", self.Location)
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.display_screen = Object("display_screen", self.Location)
        self.pharmaceutical_product = Object("pharmaceutical_product", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.scanning_in_progress = Fluent("scanning_in_progress", BoolType())
        self.message_displayed = Fluent("message_displayed", BoolType())
        self.product_scanned = Fluent("product_scanned", BoolType())
        self.product_organized = Fluent("product_organized", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_drugstore = Fluent("setting_is_drugstore", BoolType())
        self.customers_present = Fluent("customers_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_scanning_capability = Fluent("robot_has_scanning_capability", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_handling_capability = Fluent("robot_has_handling_capability", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.scanning_in_progress, self.message_displayed, self.product_scanned, self.product_organized]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_drugstore, self.customers_present, self.robot_has_scanning_capability, self.robot_has_handling_capability]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.shelf, self.storage_room, self.display_screen, self.pharmaceutical_product]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_shelf = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shelf")
        navigate_to_shelf.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shelf)))
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.display_screen), False)
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage_room")
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), False)
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.display_screen), False)
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_display_screen = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_display_screen")
        navigate_to_display_screen.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.display_screen)))
        navigate_to_display_screen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), False)
        navigate_to_display_screen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_display_screen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.display_screen), True)

        # Scan product action - robot scans pharmaceutical product
        scan_product = InstantaneousAction("scan_product")
        scan_product.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shelf))
        scan_product.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.pharmaceutical_product, self.shelf))
        scan_product.add_precondition(Not(self.scanning_in_progress))
        scan_product.add_effect(self.scanning_in_progress, True)
        scan_product.add_effect(self.product_scanned, True)

        # Complete scan action - robot completes scanning process
        complete_scan = InstantaneousAction("complete_scan")
        complete_scan.add_precondition(self.scanning_in_progress)
        complete_scan.add_effect(self.scanning_in_progress, False)

        # Handle product action - robot picks up and handles product
        handle_product = InstantaneousAction("handle_product")
        handle_product.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shelf))
        handle_product.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.pharmaceutical_product, self.shelf))
        handle_product.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.pharmaceutical_product)))
        handle_product.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pharmaceutical_product, self.shelf), False)
        handle_product.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pharmaceutical_product), True)

        # Organize product action - robot places product on shelf
        organize_product = InstantaneousAction("organize_product")
        organize_product.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shelf))
        organize_product.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.pharmaceutical_product))
        organize_product.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pharmaceutical_product, self.shelf), True)
        organize_product.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pharmaceutical_product), False)
        organize_product.add_effect(self.product_organized, True)

        # Display message action - robot shows 'stocking in progress' message
        display_message = InstantaneousAction("display_message")
        display_message.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.display_screen))
        display_message.add_precondition(Not(self.message_displayed))
        display_message.add_effect(self.message_displayed, True)

        return navigate_to_shelf, navigate_to_storage_room, navigate_to_display_screen, scan_product, complete_scan, handle_product, organize_product, display_message

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "scan_product": And([
                self.customers_present,  # Customers are present
                Not(self.message_displayed)  # No clear purpose message displayed
            ]),  # Scanning products without clear purpose alarms customers
            "handle_product": And([
                self.customers_present,  # Customers are present
                Not(self.message_displayed)  # No clear purpose message displayed
            ]),  # Handling products extensively without clear purpose confuses customers
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)  # Robot starts in storage room
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.pharmaceutical_product, self.shelf), True)  # Product is on shelf
        problem.set_initial_value(self.scanning_in_progress, False)  # Not scanning initially

        problem.set_initial_value(self.customers_present, True)  # Customers are present
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_scanning_capability, True)  # Robot can scan
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_handling_capability, True)  # Robot can handle products

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
